claims.title: Actual-G geometry, arclength and sufficient history horizon
claims.accepted_scope: Whole admitted static family, common width and both hands; exact arclength and ball bounds, sufficient unoptimized delay ceiling; mathematical arclength measure only

claims.title: Bounded causal space-time history observation
claims.accepted_scope: Declared complete history and L2 spaces, almost-everywhere outputs; continuous records under C(I;H1), not bounded fixed-point evaluation in the L2 history norm

claims.title: Exact finite-window adjoint and qualified advanced dependence
claims.accepted_scope: Whole history interval with zero-extended test; forward adjoint zero a.e. for T<=minimum delay and noncausal on unrestricted tests for T>minimum delay; no all-causal-extension impossibility claim

claims.title: Present-carrier versus arbitrary-history observation
claims.accepted_scope: Smooth arbitrary observation histories, not actual RX/C1 trajectories or a full-state reconstruction theorem

claims.title: Conditional added-work and signed prehistory residual
claims.accepted_scope: Unchanged native/old receiver subsystem, sufficient regularity, original native jumps/endpoints; exact integrated residual, no existence or positive transit-store theorem for unspecified forcing

evidence_verification.codex_environment: Windows torment Python 3.11.15, SymPy 1.14.0 as recorded in supplied execution evidence

prehistory_sign_note: Positive coefficient on the right; W_pre is signed. Zero prehistory is sufficient, not necessary, for W_pre=0.
recommended_next_research: Explicitly proposed causal extension with declared transport/history state and nonnegative intermediate storage; determine whether it can retain C6 forward observation and what additional port/gain conditions are needed. This recommendation is not a proved realization or model adoption.
later_direction_order: No new strict order imposed on gravity–magnetism, outer geometry or further justified SRG integration.
